connector.name: Mailbuttons (mbag.ai)
connector.registryDescription: Governed email for AI agents (Mailbuttons / mbag.ai): sandbox inboxes, policy gate, audit log.
connector.summary: Hosted at mailbuttons.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.mailbuttons, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: a scoped Mailbuttons MCP token, sent as 'Bearer mb_sandbox_...' (or mb_prod_...). Create one in the dashboard, or via POST /api/v1/mcp/sandbox-inboxes.

env.name: MAILBUTTONS_API_KEY
env.description: A scoped Mailbuttons MCP token (mb_sandbox_...). Sandbox-by-default; external send requires human promotion.

env.name: MAILBUTTONS_API_URL
env.description: Backend base URL. Defaults to https://mailbuttons.com; set for self-hosted or local.
